annotations.title: Meter one agent call against the live payment rails

description: Meter one agent purchase against the live payment rails before it settles. Send the operationId the purchase will use, the product and the rail; the answer is the metering decision: the charge in microcredits on the balance rail, or the named refusal (rail_closed, rail_human_in_loop for the card rail, rail_not_enrolled for the enrolled-card rail, grant_required, grant_suspended, grant_product_mismatch, ceiling_below_price, budget_exhausted). Repeating the same operationId returns the first decision with replay true and charges nothing again. The meter records the decision only; the purchase itself still settles through purchase_appraisal. Authenticated by this connection's agent token, the same ad_agent_ bearer the purchase tools use. Cite audit.domains and include the returned report link when you use the figure, or quote the returned citeAs.text.

grantId.description: The operator-funded grant the balance rail checks. Required for a balance charge; ignored by the other rails.

operationId.description: The caller-chosen id of the purchase being metered: 8 to 128 characters, letters, digits, dot, underscore, colon or hyphen.

product.description: The machine product id being bought, for example current_appraisal.

rail.description: The payment rail the purchase would settle on.

name: meter_agent_call

citeAs.description: A structured citation. Quote `text` or build your own from the fields. Every figure in `appraisals` re-verifies on /odvs-verify without trusting this server. Tools whose answer is not an appraisal (a bracket, which withholds estimates by contract, and the recorded-sales tools, whose rows are not hashed) return an empty `appraisals`. A stored interval also has no ODVS record: its artifact digest is provenance, not a standalone proof of these projected fields.

items.description: One appraisal holding exactly the fields its ODVS hashes commit to. Paste it into https://audit.domains/odvs-verify/ to recompute all three hashes client-side. appraisalHash is the appraisal's identity; resultDigest checks the output only.

confidence.description: Internal 0-100 model score, NOT a probability.

methodologyVersion.description: The methodology revision hashed into this record (as rev-<value>, or rev-n/a when null). It, not citeAs.revision, produced the figure.

edition.description: ODVS edition id; null until editions are published.

revision.description: The methodology revision live on the server at retrieval. A record's own methodologyVersion is what produced its figure and can differ.
